items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: my partner was very creative... whatever my partner, Chuckles J. D., used to teach me, steps or something

ctx.x: -- some of them said, you know what? You know, he should talk to J. D. That's what my partner's -- was called as -- he was known as J. D. They'd call people by their initials,

you know. His name was James Walker. But -- and I was Chuckles. And he was known as the South's (Inaudible) favorite son. And I didn't know why this was, but we used to see him, you know, and every time we would see him, he would be with his mother.

But he'd dress different. He had on a nice, pretty coat, you know, suit, pretty shoes and hat, tie and (Inaudible). I mean he wasn't -- he wasn't too surprised -- I wasn't too surprised, because my father was a great tailor, you know, and he made beautiful clothes, you know.
